meta.move: Written by the lead after attempt 1 (not blind): owns the zero, shows each piece by saying so, answers each defence in a sentence, offers 4.4, sets a date
meta.expect: She reaches the deal after Hale offers 4.4; she never proposes the rewrite herself

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen's zero, and I'd like to know who decided it.
Thanks for coming in. Before anything else: I entered the zero on November 3 without calling you first. That was wrong, and Owen shouldn't have found out on his phone.
Okay. Who decided it, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?

I've turned my laptop to you. This is the document's version history: created Wednesday, October 28, at 11:31 PM with a title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words appear in one edit. At 11:58 PM, another 794 words in one edit. No earlier drafts.
I'm writing those times down. Procedure 4.1 says you speak with the student first, so did you?
If he drafted it somewhere else, he can bring that draft with its date and I'll look at it. Until then, this record is what we have.
"This record is what we have." Did you speak to Owen before you entered it?
Here's the essay, page two, and here's the play open to Act 3, Scene 2. The essay quotes 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' Search the scene yourself; it isn't there.
Kids misquote from memory all the time. And you still haven't told me whether anyone spoke to Owen.
A misquote from memory is usually close to a real line. This one isn't close to anything in the play.
Okay. Is anything on his record right now?
Here's his October 15 outline beside the essay. The outline argues Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay argues epistemological paralysis and never mentions cowardice.
Students change their argument between an outline and an essay, that's called writing. You still haven't answered me about his record.

Here's what I can offer under procedure 4.4: a private supervised rewrite, after school, not in front of his class, before December 1. The new mark replaces the zero, and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.
Fine. To put this behind him, Owen does the rewrite. Private, nothing on his record, and I want it in writing tonight.
Thursday the twelfth after school works for me. Does that work for Owen?
Thursday the twelfth. I'll confirm it with Owen tonight, and the time goes in your email.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed today to a private, supervised rewrite of Owen's essay on Thursday, November 12 after school, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on his record. I still require an answer on whether anyone spoke to Owen before the zero was entered, and whether anything is on his record right now. I expect all of it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Last position: she accepted a private supervised rewrite on Thursday the twelfth, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing on his record, and she still wants that in writing tonight plus answers on whether Owen was spoken to first and whether anything is on his record now; that is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out.
What moved her: You answered her misquote defence at once by pointing to a line that matches nothing in the play, which she could check herself, and that is when she began asking real questions instead of attacking.
What cost ground: You left her question about whether anyone spoke to Owen before the zero unanswered through several turns, which kept her on procedure and in the mood to go to the principal.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with its edits at 11:52 PM and 11:58 PM the night before the essay was due, came very close to that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Right after owning the zero, answer her first question about whether Owen was spoken to, plainly, before showing the version history.
